map_geometry.note: Blue Test Lab is the default. Procedural maps can be exported; editable JSON maps load via --map.

map_editing.note: Change both validation and tools documentation for schema changes.

props.note: Preserve IDs; regenerate JSON exports into a new directory.

checks: Feta furniture passages, solid legs/undersides, Scientist exclusion, four-map desks
dropped-prop overlap recovery for both characters; wall exclusion and stable feet
movement.note: Keep frame-rate independence and render/headless parity.

graphics.note: Simple matte geometry uses tag 3; do not tint it with crystal tag 2. Pause shows Resume/Settings/Quit; controls and options are in Settings.

wrench.note: Sound observes confirmed impacts; keep audio out of headless.

interactions.note: Keep semantic IDs stable. Map document v1 supports inspect actions only.

checks: furniture camera clearance and 30/60/144 Hz obstruction-release tests
camera_character.note: Scientist and Feta procedural skins; CharacterKind controls body/collision/speed. Launch selection gates gameplay. Q toggles perspective; reset preserves profile. Feta uses a low centered pitch-independent boom; CameraRig smooths obstruction release and rechecks current-pose collisions.

checks: cargo test --locked --no-default-features --test multiplayer_transport --test content_handshake --test secure_net --test transport_profiles --test doc_drift
multiplayer.note: Transport-agnostic authoritative server with explicit development/raw-UDP and production/QUIC-TLS profiles, 60 Hz authority, 20 Hz acknowledged deltas/keyframes, prediction, ownership, and combat. Protocol 5 rejects mismatched content; optional HMAC supplies client authentication on either profile. One authoritative registry owns session tokens and timeout cleanup; secure-random failures fail closed and keyed disconnects require credentials.

performance_regression_budgets.note: Canonical headless measurements are checked against shared absolute service ceilings; tests and the CLI fail nonzero on regression. Thresholds include heterogeneous CI headroom and are not hardware-normalized baselines.

offline_renderer.note: Read ARCHITECTURE.md and AI_REFERENCE.md before changes.

landscaping.note: Reusable static broadleaf, pine, clustered shrub and flower builders. Preserve collision routes; no alpha textures or animation.

source_free_authoring.note: Packaged-native static map authoring; curated metadata and local bounded token search; no engine source reads, embeddings or arbitrary gameplay scripting.

asset_library.note: Unified JSON catalog API over native and data-only prefabs; qualified stable IDs, metadata search, external game-local packs and review-gated promotion proposals. Reuse, modify, generate, then import.

interior_prefabs.note: Data-only prefab scenes and quarter-turn placement; preserves source and validates with packaged native audit.

checks: simulation_flow integration tests in both feature configurations
library rustdoc with warnings denied in both feature configurations
simulation_contract.note: Concrete rendering-free simulation; held input persists and jump is consumed once. DedicatedServer enforces input ordering and stale-input expiry.

checks: prop_physics tests in both feature configurations
live E pickup/drop, pause/resume and both movement key layouts
prop_physics.note: Runtime catalog-prop extraction; 120 Hz Rapier compound bodies with per-player authoritative ownership. Large furniture/wall art remain fixed. All eligible bodies are allocated up front; lifecycle sleeping is not lazy allocation.

weapons.note: Scientist primary wrench and scroll-selected black pistol with infinite ammo prototype, hitscan raycasts, recoil, muzzle flash, third-person aiming and audio.

checks: fps module tests in both feature configurations
Cobalt Foundry audit, lint and reachability
fps_foundation.note: Rendering-independent FPS domain: validated catalogs, ten-firearm starter armory, deterministic fixed-tick fire/reload/burst timing, reproducible spread, smooth ADS/FOV, operative archetypes, and authoritative team deathmatch health/scoring/respawns. Games own presentation, hit-shape policy and their transport shell.

checks: arena module tests in both feature configurations
arena_shooter_foundation.note: Opt-in, rendering-independent arena FPS layer: validated accelerated ground/air movement, configurable grounded step-up, friction, held-jump momentum chaining, 90-degree camera policy, launch volumes, timed pickups, deterministic projectiles and splash falloff, armor, free-for-all frags and fixed-tick respawns. Existing default movement remains unchanged.

prototype_api.note: SceneBuilder requires an explicit spawn and batches ordinary map edits; box_body includes a semantic ID while structural_box creates visual collision without a reachability target. World impulse/prop_position use IDs, not borrowed body indices. HeadlessWorld supports transactional map/game replacement with player respawn; network hosts must coordinate content changes. No generic scripting or arbitrary dynamic mesh builder.

native_discovery.note: describe and bounded search use the CLI command registry and embedded feature index. export-lab creates a validated authoring starter. Evidence names and files must resolve; their tests run in the ordinary CI suite.

game_documents.note: GameDocument v1: movement profile, spawns, bounded interaction rules/counters and server-owned objective state. Eligibility and presentation visibility are independent replicated states; hidden entities retain collision. Native game-describe/schema/validate/example; --game on client and headless. No scripting or physical doors.

custom_clients.note: Documented application-owned window/render/input boundary over BlueEngine-owned fixed simulation, including the supported Macroquad version for external crates.

mcp.note: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server directly exposing level authoring, inspection, pathing, linting, and simulation tools over stdio JSON-RPC.

checks: blueprint compilation and spatial room graph
blueprint.note: Declarative multi-room level compiler generating validated maps with door cutouts, spawns, catalog props, and spatial RoomGraphs.

static_lint.note: Level design static analysis catching missing/blocked explicit spawns, floating/sunk props, dropped hazards, perimeter leaks, overlaps, headroom violations, and unreachable semantic entities; structural boxes are excluded.

checks: A* pathfinding and 60 Hz physics walk simulation
pathing_and_walk.note: Capsule clearance A* pathfinding and 60 Hz physics walk simulation with collision blocker diagnostics and SVG diagram generation.

procedural_gen.note: Deterministic procedural scatter and line placement with ground snapping and collision avoidance.

checks: headless simulation scenarios and replay trace verification
simulation_scenarios.note: External behavioral driver with scenario-relative game paths, timestamped public inputs, structured state assertions, and deterministic replay divergence diagnostics.

verification_framework.note: Single-command map verification executing lint, reachability, physical walks, object assertions, and scenarios in one shot.

checks: source code index, search, and outline
source_navigator.note: High-performance Rust source navigator indexing modules, functions, structs, enums, signatures, and cross-references.

ui_auditor.note: Headless 2D UI layout auditor validating all screens across 9 standard resolutions for overlap, text truncation, and responsive pause menu constraints.

game_scaffolding.note: Scaffolds complete, independent game repositories with pinned vesper3d dependency, blueprint, map, launcher, test scripts, and CI.

checks: game still/menu captures and live controls
game_presentation.note: Shared F fullscreen, compact Escape menu, neutral gameplay input, cached shaded static primitives, minimal HUD policy and bounded snapshot smoothing. Static-only worlds avoid invisible movable-prop physics. Immutable font atlas, cached beveled firearm viewmodels, cosmetic shot feedback, world materials/signs, and swept local camera presentation.
